text: gsettings set org.gnome.shell favorite-apps "$(gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps | python3 -c 'import sys,ast; l=ast.literal_eval(sys.stdin.read().strip()); print([x for x in l if "vim" not in x.lower()])')"
memo: Ran a command that reads favorite-apps, filters out any entry containing 'vim', and writes it back. Next: verify with `gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps` and check the dash no longer lists Vim (dash previously: Thunderbird, Vim, Chrome, Terminal).
